scientific.integrity: The window-incidence equivalence is analytic. The source's cumulative-incidence classification was checked in the primary full text. The checker only validates the algebra of the reported twofold parameter involution. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The equivalence is for perfect continuous sliding-window incidence, not a finite reporting grid. It does not assert equal Fisher information or equal practical estimability. The convergence argument uses the closed nonnegative SEIR identity C(t)=C(0)+S(0)-S(t).

title: Fixed-window incidence has exactly the same structural parameter ambiguity as cumulative incidence in the closed SEIR model
